import ast
import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.games import make_game
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path = Path('results/training/qwen38_selected_test_completion.json')
assert not path.exists()
launch_path = Path('results/training/qwen38_selected_test.json')
launch = json.loads(launch_path.read_text())
assert launch['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
selection_path = Path('results/training/qwen38_selection.json')
assert file_sha256(selection_path) == launch['selection_sha256']
selection = json.loads(selection_path.read_text())
assert selection['status'] == 'frozen' and selection['eval_batch_size'] == 4
assert file_sha256(selection['adapter_file']) == selection['adapter_sha256']
root = Path(f"results/kaggle/qwen38-selected-test-v{launch['version']}")
source = Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_selected_test/grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py')
assert file_sha256(source) == launch['source_sha256']
core = next(n.args[0].value for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source.read_text())) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == 'write_text' and isinstance(n.args[0], ast.Constant))
assert (root / 'evaluate_core.py').read_text() == core
label = selection['label']
work = root / label
pair = json.loads((root / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
assert pair['evaluation_seed'] == 200 and pair['episodes_per_game'] == 200 and pair['batch_size'] == 4
runtime = json.loads((work / 'runtime.json').read_text())
cohorts = {}
for game in ('dice', 'cards'):
    cohorts[game] = {}
    for player in (label, 'bayes'):
        raw = work / f'results/raw/{game}/{player}.jsonl'
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()] if raw.exists() else []
        assert [r['seed'] for r in rows] == list(range(200, 200 + len(rows)))
        if player == label:
            assert len(rows) % 4 == 0
        for row in rows:
            canonical = make_game(game).episode(row['seed'])
            assert row['player'] == player and row['game'] == game
            assert row['value'] == canonical.value and len(row['rounds']) == 6
            assert [r['reveal'] for r in row['rounds']] == canonical.reveals
            if player == label:
                cfg = row['provenance']['config']
                assert cfg['seed'] == 0 and cfg['eval_batch_size'] == 4
                assert cfg['adapter_sha256'] == selection['adapter_sha256']
                assert cfg['revision'] == selection['provenance']['model_revision']
        cohorts[game][player] = {'file': str(raw), 'sha256': file_sha256(raw) if raw.exists() else None,
                                'episodes': len(rows), 'complete': len(rows) == 200, 'canonical_games_verified': True}
complete = all(c['complete'] for players in cohorts.values() for c in players.values())
copied = {}
if complete:
    canonical = Path(selection['test_root'])
    assert not canonical.exists(), 'Keep any prior canonical acquisition immutable'
    shutil.copytree(work / 'results', canonical)
    for original in (work / 'results').rglob('*'):
        if original.is_file():
            copy = canonical / original.relative_to(work / 'results')
            assert file_sha256(copy) == file_sha256(original)
            copied[str(copy)] = file_sha256(copy)
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain the sole frozen 27B test and publish only verified complete cohorts'}, runtime['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status': 'complete' if complete else 'partial_test_retained',
          'selection_sha256': file_sha256(selection_path), 'launch_sha256': file_sha256(launch_path),
          'cohorts': cohorts, 'runtime': runtime, 'pair_runtime': pair, 'canonical_copies': copied,
          'downloaded_files': {str(p): {'sha256': file_sha256(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size} for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},
          'scope': 'One frozen policy, 200/game. Original downloaded version unchanged; partial cohorts are not scored.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
p = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(p.read_text())
session = next(s for s in ledger['sessions'] if s['kernel'] == launch['metadata']['id'] and s['version'] == launch['version'])
session.update(status=record['status'], hours=pair['wall_seconds'] / 3600, script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'],
               script_started_at=runtime['execution_started_at'], script_finished_at=runtime.get('execution_finished_at'),
               result_file=str(root / 'pair_runtime.json'), hours_basis='Downloaded complete wrapper runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.')
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Retained selected 27B test', {g: {n: c['episodes'] for n, c in players.items()} for g, players in cohorts.items()}, flush=True)
